41: NAN. What with? MÍTRITCH. He takes a birch-broom with him.
39: MÍTRITCH. Why, like this! When he finds such a one as you, who won't sleep, he comes with a sack and pops the girl into it, then in he gets himself, head and all, lifts her dress, and gives her a fine whipping!
37: MÍTRITCH. Now then, what d'you want?
35: NAN [ whispers ] Daddy! I say, daddy! Are you asleep?
32: MÍTRITCH. Frightful? Don't be afraid and then it won't be frightful. Look at her, she's afraid, and then says it's frightful. How can it help being frightful if you are afraid? Eh, what a stupid little girl!
30: NAN. Daddy darling, don't put it out! I won't … truly, truly, I won't. It's so frightful!
28: MÍTRITCH. What are you dreaming about? Digging! Digging in the night! Who's digging? The cow's rubbing herself, that's all. Digging indeed! Go to sleep I tell you, else I'll just put out the light!
26: NAN. Daddy! Daddy, I say! They are digging! they're digging—don't you hear? Blest if they're not, they're digging!
25: MÍTRITCH. What else? Do you think I'm going to sing songs? Silence.
23: NAN. Daddy! are you going to sleep?
21: MÍTRITCH. Why, just his very self! [ Climbs up on to the oven ] The oven is beautifully warm to-night. Quite a treat! Oh Lord! Gracious Nicholas!
19: MÍTRITCH. Heard indeed! Much you heard! Well, if you know,—why then it was just such a little girl as you that the bogey popped into his bag and made off with.
18: NAN. But I heard it! Blest if I didn't hear it! Such a thin voice!
17: MÍTRITCH. There is none, that's why you can't hear it.
15: MÍTRITCH. Oh Lord! Gracious Nicholas! What is it you can't hear?
14: NAN. It gave just one cry, and now there's nothing to be heard.
12: MÍTRITCH. Well, of course! What a little silly you are, now I come to look at you! Must needs know everything. [ Tucks her up again, then stands up to go ] There now, lie still and sleep! [ Goes up to the oven ].
10: NAN. And you are going to lie on the oven?
8: MÍTRITCH. Eh, what a little busybody it is! May the frogs kick her! Must needs know everything. Lie down and sleep! [ Nan lies down ] That's right! [ Tucks her up ] That's right! There now, if you know too much you'll grow old too soon.
6: NAN. How can one help being frightened, daddy! Sister did go on so! She was beating her head against the box! [ Whispers ] You know, I know … a little baby is going to be born.… It's already born, I think.…
5: MÍTRITCH [ laughs ] All right, all right. [ Sits down by her ] What's there to be afraid of?
3: NAN. Daddy darling! Don't put it right out; leave a little bit if only as big as a mouse's eye, else it's so frightening!
1: MÍTRITCH. What's that to you? I guess no one's asked you to mind! Lie down and sleep! And I'll turn down the light. [ Turns down lamp ].
0: MÍTRITCH. Not put it out? Why? NAN. Didn't you hear them making a row in the yard? [ Listens ] D'you hear, there in the barn again now?
